_meta.purpose: Phase 7 model registry. One entry per model in the A/B/C comparative study, so B and C slot in beside A on identical fields rather than being described ad hoc later.
_meta.schema_note: Every model carries the same keys. 'status' is the only field that distinguishes a built model from a declared one: 'serving' | 'trained' | 'planned'. A 'planned' entry has null in every measured field — never a placeholder number, never an estimate.
_meta.measurement_discipline: Magnitude and direction are reported separately and are never blended into one score, per electoral/metrics/ground_truth_accuracy.py's structural separation. Any caveat attached to a number travels with that number; do not quote a characterization figure without its caveat.
_meta.provenance_warning: Model A's measured figures were produced on Hopper (CMC HPC). As of 2026-08-17 the underlying artifacts (reports/hybrid_003_panel_score.json, artifacts/mobilization_confound_probe_results.json, and the fair-comparison outputs) have NOT been rsynced into this checkout. The figures below are transcribed from devlog/2026-08-15-three-models-one-question.md and the run owner's account, and are corroborated by each other but not independently re-derivable here. Verify against Hopper before treating any of them as re-checked.
_meta.registry_is_not_a_deployment_record: This file records what each model IS, not what is currently served. What Modal serves is governed by deploy/modal_app.py, which this file deliberately does not touch and cannot confirm. See docs/models/model-a-hybrid.md for the open git-tracking gap on that.

A.label: Model A — hybrid (scale-corrected corpus + mobilization override)

recipe.recipe_note: Deliberately identical to the prior clean adapter's recipe so that any behavioural difference is attributable to the corpus alone.

distinguishing_features: delta bins on the corrected +/-0.03 scale (factor-0.25 rescale, Phase 2 Step 2.1)
explicit mobilization override in the label generator: the declared beneficiary determines net sign before sentiment is considered

training_gate.note: Hopper-side. This checkout's artifacts/phase6_step6_4_training_manifest.json still reads status='prepared_not_trained' and is STALE — it is not evidence the run did not happen.

A.panel_policy: post_training_calibration_check_only; no panel cells materialized into train or eval
A.probe_policy: evaluation_only; never trained or eval-split on

characterization._note: MEASURED, not aspirational. Magnitude and direction are separate dimensions and are never combined.

magnitude.reading: Slightly conservative — under-predicts. This is the direct, measured payoff of the delta-bin rescale; the two older adapters over-predict by 20-30%.

direction.caveat: 0.875 is 7/8 cells across only 3 independent temporal windows, concentrated in the white and catholic blocs. This is a subset of the wider 19-of-270 direction-trustworthy panel figure. It is a statistical-power limit, not a window-quality problem. Never quote 0.875 without this caveat: it is a hint, not a proof, and 'best of three adapters' does not change that.

rank_correlation.reading: The one axis Model A loses on. v3 scored +0.61 on the same 2 shocks. Both estimates sit near the measurement floor and are noisy. Recorded, not buried — but it does not overturn the magnitude and probe results.

confound_probe.miss: probe_dem_school_policy_backlash — attributed to an unusually strong culturally-coded sentiment prior overriding the mobilization logic

ablation.reading: All three share a base model and QLoRA recipe, so this isolates the scale-corrected corpus plus explicit mobilization override as the cause of confound resistance — not the base model, not luck. grounded-v1 at 5/10 is a coin flip (no signal). v3 at 3/10 is BELOW chance, with 7 of 10 answers sentiment-fallbacks: v3 does not fail to know the answer, it confidently knows the wrong one.

confound_probe.scope_qualifier: Model A uses beneficiary information when it is STATED in the event text; it does NOT infer beneficiary from a bare event description. Bare free-text inputs produce sentiment-fallback (mirror-image) predictions. Every probe record states its beneficiary, so 9/10 measures USE, not INFERENCE. Pending serve-time preprocessing.
confound_probe.scope_qualifier_status: PENDING VERIFICATION — the inference-vs-use distinction is the hypothesis under test by scripts/test_serving_prompt_sensitivity.py (see RUN_ON_HOPPER_PHASE7_1.md). Update this field with what that test actually finds, whichever way it goes.
confound_probe.status: strong on stated beneficiary; unverified on inferred beneficiary

A.honest_one_line: Magnitude-calibrated and confound-robust on stated-beneficiary inputs — NOT a validated fine-grained per-bloc predictor.
not_validated_for: predicting WHICH bloc moves most (per-bloc direction ordering is weak across all three adapters, Model A included)
inferring a beneficiary from bare event text (open; under test)

serving.precision: full precision (float16); load via load_model(..., use_quantization=False)
serving.quantization_reason: 4-bit loading causes NoneType errors when outlines reorders the KV cache across PEFT adapter layers.
serving.peft_config_strip_note: Modal pins peft==0.13.2 (newest compatible with its co-pinned huggingface-hub==0.24.7). Hopper trains with peft==0.19.1, whose adapter_config.json carries fields 0.13.2 rejects (exclude_modules, qalora_group_size, alora_invocation_tokens, ...), raising 'LoraConfig.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument'. Before uploading, strip adapter_config.json to the basic LoRA fields (r, lora_alpha, lora_dropout, target_modules, task_type, peft_type, base_model_name_or_path, bias, plus null standards); leave the pristine Hopper-side config untouched. This is a known-fragile manual workaround, not automated by any script in this repo, and must be repeated for every future adapter until the whole Modal stack is bumped and re-evaluated.
serving.prompt_path: ShockEstimator.estimate() -> format_prompt(event_dict) -> [INST]...[/INST], decoded against nested ShockResponseSchema. NOT predict_delta_bins(), which prefixes <s> and uses a flat 15-bloc schema.

B.label: Model B — frontier-distilled (0.03 scale)
B.stub_note: Declared, not built. No artifacts exist. Must be trained on the same corrected +/-0.03 delta scale as Model A and evaluated with the same protocol (RUN_ON_HOPPER.md section 4 + the confound probe) or the comparison against A is not fair.

C.label: Model C — live frontier model (password-gated, server-side keys)

serving.key_handling: server-side keys only — never expose provider credentials to the client
serving.note: Access model declared at registration; no implementation exists.

C.stub_note: Declared, not built. Not fine-tuned, so it has no corpus or recipe to control for — the A/B/C comparison must therefore state plainly which differences are attributable to corpus and which to a wholly different model class. A live API model is also not pinnable, which is a reproducibility caveat the paper must carry.

comparative_study.blocking_constraint: The serve-time preprocessing decision must be resolved BEFORE the A/B/C comparison runs. Bare-text inputs disadvantage Model A on beneficiary inference — a dimension the comparison would otherwise silently conflate with model quality. See the Phase 7 design-constraint entry in DECISIONS.md.
fairness_requirements: identical ground-truth shock set across all models
identical input preprocessing — whatever is decided, applied to all three
magnitude and direction reported separately, never pooled
held-out and trainable subsets reported separately, never blended
refusals reported as required output, not pooled away
